lead: A `#[cfg_attr(not(test), expect(dead_code))]` on a module covers nothing the `cfg(test)` build adds to it.
body: `crates/nvs-cli/src/service.rs`'s `registration` carries one, so an applier landed ahead of its caller compiles silently under `cargo build` and then warns under `cargo clippy --all-targets`, which is the only leg that builds the test copy at all. Give each such item its own `#[cfg_attr(test, expect(dead_code, reason = …))]`, and reach for `cargo clippy --all-targets` rather than `cargo build` while a seam still has no caller.

until.arg: crates/nvs-cli/src/service.rs:the subcommands that reach this seam
